summary: BHG EIENDOM AS (org. no. 979 493 517) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bergen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1997-12-30. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom); it has 7 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 1.6 m and net income was NOK 20.2 m. Group (consolidated) revenue was NOK 163.2 m. CEO: Erling Falch Monsen; board chair: Børge Knustad; auditor: DELOITTE AS. Also: LEI 549300MXTCTYBGQ4CL09.
